Cricket X – The Ultimate VR Cricket Experience on Meta Quest!
Step into the crease with Cricket X, the most immersive and realistic VR cricket game designed to sharpen your batting skills and deliver hours of entertainment. Whether you’re chasing thrilling targets, perfecting your shots, or taking on exciting challenges, Cricket X is the ultimate VR cricket training simulator for players of all levels.

Game Modes
•	Challenge Mode: Set your target score, overs, and wickets. Chase totals and test your strategy and accuracy.
•	Training Mode: Recreate any delivery you want by customizing swing, spin, speed, bowler type, bounce, and pitch pace. Set the line and length to perfect every shot and refine your skills.
•	Demo Mode: Face deliveries with increasing difficulty, with voice-over hints announcing each ball—keeping you focused and ready.
•	Special Challenge Mode: Take on thrilling challenges featuring unique and unpredictable deliveries to push your batting skills.

Key Features
•	Day & Night Mode: Play in dynamic lighting for a realistic stadium feel.
•	Realistic Physics: Experience true-to-life ball swing, spin, and bounce.
•	Replay & Analytics: Analyze your shots with replays, pitch maps, and scoring zones.
•	Batting Styles: Switch between left-hand and right-hand batting seamlessly.
•	Real Bat Support: Attach your controller to a real bat for maximum immersion.
•	Passthrough Mode: Play safely with real-world visuals around you.

Play Cricket X – The Next Level of VR Cricket!

changelog.change_log:
Enhanced Tutorial Mode: Experience a revamped tutorial with new voiceovers and visual guidelines to help you master the game effortlessly.

Upgraded Stadium: Enjoy improved graphics and details in the stadiums for a more immersive experience.

Scoreboard Updates: Minor tweaks have been made to improve the scoreboard’s readability and design.

Wicket Changes: Updated visuals for a fresh gameplay feel.

New Ball Options: Choose from a variety of cricket balls, including pink, red, and white.

Improved Accessibility: The bat mapping mode button is now conveniently located outside the game settings for easier access and better usability.

Main Menu Redesign: Experience a cleaner and more intuitive main menu UI.

Bug Fixes:
Addressed several known bugs to enhance overall game performance and stability.

New Challenges in Challenge Mode:
Yorker Precision Test: Prove your mastery by handling toe-crushing yorkers with pinpoint accuracy.
Bouncer Accuracy Blitz: Dominate bouncers with perfect timing and unmatched skill.
Cutter Clean Connection: Tackle deceptive off cutters and leg cutters to showcase your elite batting finesse.

Added Special Deliveries Mode: Special deliveries mode where you can play exciting deliveries with voice over of what's coming next.

Tutorial Mode Unleashed: A fully interactive mode designed to teach new players every essential aspect of Cricket X, setting you up for success from the first ball.

Next Ball Button Reimagined: Redesigned to perfectly complement the game’s immersive theme, making every interaction seamless and stylish.

Main Menu Lobby Design Changes: Updated with minor design enhancements for a cleaner and more polished look.

Cricket Ball Redefined: Introducing a completely revamped cricket ball design for a strikingly realistic bowling experience.

Scoreboard Revolution: The scoreboard gets a full overhaul, delivering crystal-clear updates to keep you effortlessly in sync with every match.

Bowling System Enhanced: Rebuilt from the ground up for an unparalleled experience, with expert difficulty fine-tuned to challenge even the pros.

UI Perfectly Positioned: Game settings and analytics are now thoughtfully aligned with the batting side, offering unparalleled convenience for players.

Bug Fixes & Optimization: Numerous issues squashed and refinements made to deliver a smoother, sharper, and more thrilling experience.

• New Challenge Mode: Hone your batting skills with three unique challenges designed to push your limits:
  1. Spin Challenge – Master the art of playing spin bowling.
  2. Swing Challenge – Face bowlers with Inswinging and Outswinging Deliveries.
  3. Pace Challenge – Test your reflexes against high-speed deliveries.
Earn points based on your accuracy and performance to showcase your batting prowess!
•	More Challenges Coming soon.

• Introducing Demo Mode: Experience a sequence of deliveries with escalating challenges. A guiding voice announces the type of delivery, helping players anticipate and adapt.

• Streamlined Bat Map & Pass-Through Mode: These features are now accessible directly from the game for greater convenience, removing the need to navigate through game settings.

• Updated Qaddafi Stadium: Enhanced with high-quality, improved graphics for a more immersive experience.

• Day and Night Modes Added: Experience matches in both day and night settings with high-quality lighting for a more realistic and immersive gameplay experience.

• Scoreboard Revamp: Redesigned scoreboards with improved placement and a more intuitive layout for better visibility and user experience.

• Companion Mode Optimization: Significantly reduced data exchange times to ensure faster, smoother interactions between the app and VR experience.

• Bug Fixes: Resolved several reported issues for a more stable and enjoyable gameplay experience.

• Updated Qaddafi Stadium: Enhanced with high-quality, improved graphics for a more immersive experience.

• Day and Night Modes Added: Experience matches in both day and night settings with high-quality lighting for a more realistic and immersive gameplay experience.

Version Numbering Added: VR app now display the version number for better transparency and tracking.
Enhanced Data Management: Improved the underlying data structure to optimize performance and ensure seamless integration between VR and mobile.
Expanded Analytical Data: Added more metrics to the analysis feature, enabling deeper insights into player performance and gameplay patterns.
